Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in pioneering metal-free 2D C60 covalent networks (tetragonal and hexagonal phases) as alkali-ion battery anodes, overcoming C60 aggregation and dissolution. Significance: TP-2D-C60 delivers 522 mAh g⁻¹, breaking C60's theoretical 446 mAh g⁻¹ limit, far exceeding pristine C60 (3.4 mAh g⁻¹), with demonstrated universality in sodium-ion batteries (309.9 mAh g⁻¹), rationalized by DFT binding-site and migration-barrier insights.

💡 The novelty lies in using filler-directed ionic domain engineering in blend membranes to decouple proton transport from vanadium-ion crossover—a key trade-off limiting VRFB membranes. This approach enhances proton conductivity while suppressing vanadium crossover, improving membrane selectivity and long-term VRFB durability. Its significance is enabling higher efficiency and longer operational viability for grid-scale energy storage.

item.title: Extended Active Learning-Guided Design of Multi-Component Electrolytes with Opposing Cosolvent Properties for Aqueous Zinc-Ion Batteries
item.description:
با یادگیری فعال، الکترولیت سه‌جزئی با حلال‌های کمکی دارای خواص متضاد برای باتری آبی Zn-ion طراحی شد که حفظ ۹۰.۲٪ ظرفیت پس از ۱۰۰۰ چرخه را ممکن کرد.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in an extended active learning framework that clusters cosolvents by molecular properties and optimizes pairwise combinations, discovering a nonintuitive tri-solvent electrolyte combining cosolvents with opposing properties. Its significance: this formulation disrupts hydrogen bonding while reconstructing solvation structure, enabling 90.2% capacity retention after 1,000 cycles, and demonstrates active learning can uncover unconventional electrolytes beyond human intuition.
🏷 aqueous zinc-ion battery · multi-component electrolyte · active learning · solvation structure · hydrogen-bond network

item.title: Discovering Underpotentially Deposited Crystalline Sodium Metal Nanoparticles on the Surface of Hard Carbon Anodes
item.description:
این مقاله با cryo-EM و توموگرافی الکترونی نشان می‌دهد خوشه‌های نانوی سدیم فلزی کریستالی عمدتاً روی سطح یا نزدیک سطح ذرات هارد کربن در آند باتری سدیم-یون قرار می‌گیرند.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using cryo-EM and cryo-ET to directly localize crystalline sodium metal clusters in 3D within sodiated hard carbon, revealing they reside predominantly on or near particle surfaces rather than in bulk closed nanopores. This challenges prior 2D-based interpretations and identifies particle-level surface/near-surface interfaces as key targets to mitigate underpotential sodium plating in hard carbon anodes.
🏷 hard carbon anode · sodium metal plating · cryo-EM · sodium-ion battery · underpotential deposition
